pairs.question: A company representative is calling about the Global Ready Talent Programme (GRT) after receiving an email about changes to local internship support. They have a foreign student studying in Singapore who wants to apply for support, and they want to confirm the reason for discontinuing local internship support.
pairs.expected_outcome: The representative understands that GRT local internship support is being discontinued effective 1 April 2026, that all students must be Singaporean or PR to qualify for GRT regardless of internship location, and that the programme will focus solely on overseas internships going forward.
pairs.enquiry_text: Caller would like to confirm about the reason of discontinuing support for local internships. Caller enquiring that they have a foreign student that studies in SG and wants to apply for support.
pairs.answer_text:
Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme is for internships that are based in Singapore.
All students must be Singaporean or PR for a company to apply for the Global Ready Talent Programme, even for overseas internships.
The Global Ready Talent Programme has provided over 30,000 internship opportunities across more than 4,000 companies since its launch in 2019.
Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme will be discontinued with effect from 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will focus solely on supporting overseas internships after 1 April 2026.
The Global Ready Talent Programme will continue to support overseas internships through allowances to students via institutes of higher learning.

claims.claim: Local internship support under the Global Ready Talent Programme is for internships that are based in Singapore.
All students must be Singaporean or PR for a company to apply for the Global Ready Talent Programme, even for overseas internships.

The Global Ready Talent Programme will continue to support overseas internships through allowances to students via institutes of higher learning.

pairs.answer_text:
The PSG grant supports purchase of POS systems.
Callers can use the Solutions Directory on the GoBusiness site PSG page to look for available POS systems.
Callers must consider their SSIC Code for the Sector when looking at PSG solutions.
If the caller's sector is not listed in the Solutions Directory, the caller may consider grants indicated under the Generic (non-sector specific) section.
For PSG IT Solutions, callers have to get the solution as listed and from the Pre-Approved vendor.
PSG IT Solutions support is for the first time adoption of a solution.
If a company applied for that category of solution in the past, the company will not be able to get the PSG support.
The BGP User Guide for applying for PSG support can be found on the Enterprise SG site PSG page under the How to apply section Step 4.
The PSG application process includes confirming the solution wanted in the directory, then going to the BGP to make a submission for review and approval of the PO.
